The paragraph describes a messaging app using "Quantum-Resistant Encryption." Assessing its effectiveness in the current landscape is challenging because, while it offers proactive defense against future quantum threats, quantum computers are not yet widely available for practical decryption attacks. Therefore, its real-world effectiveness against current threats is difficult to measure, though it is theoretically sound for future-proofing.
